svg.aria-label: Install DataForSEO Agent in three commands: tools/install.sh, then dataforseo-agent-setup connects your DataForSEO API account, sets the session budget and market, and picks a model, then dfa starts the app. Press start: the three bots boot up while the counters fill to 14 agents and 33 SEO workflow skills.
